cases.current_response: Use College of the Sequoias Industrial Maintenance and Industrial Automation as the shared technical core, and use the Tulare-Kings Industrial Partnership / Good Jobs Challenge to close employer-validated gaps through hands-on training and OJT before adding broad new programs.
cases.decision_trigger: Add a program, module or capital investment only when multiple employers validate the same recurring gap and the existing COS plus OJT response cannot meet it.

cases.title: Nursing & Clinical Capacity
cases.current_response: Use College of the Sequoias' existing large RN platform and diagnose clinical, faculty, completion, transition-to-practice and retention constraints before increasing general capacity.
cases.decision_trigger: Expand general RN capacity only when the verified bottleneck is addressable through additional seats and clinical/faculty capacity can support sustainable added completions.

cases.title: Electrical & Industrial Trades
cases.current_response: Use COS state-approved electrical training and Central California Electrical Training Institute as the core pathway. Strengthen entry, apprenticeship conversion and paid work capacity before adding parallel general programs.
cases.decision_trigger: Add related instruction or a parallel pathway only when instruction, rather than paid work, sponsorship, dispatch, supervision or applicant preparation, is the verified bottleneck.

training.title: Yuba City Regional Training Opportunity Brief

cases.title: Defense & Aircraft Maintenance
cases.current_response: Use Beale's employer-led military and civilian-agency maintenance training as the mission-specific core. Use Yuba College technical programs for portable feeder skills and create a dedicated civilian aviation pathway only if recurring civilian hiring and credential evidence justify it.
cases.decision_trigger: Create a dedicated civilian aviation pathway only when recurring civilian hiring, credential requirements and access gaps show that employer-led and regional aviation pathways cannot meet demand.

cases.title: Clinical & Public Health Capacity
cases.current_response: Use Yuba College's existing RN program as the clinical training base and target occupation-specific public-health and clinical vacancies. Expand only when seats, clinical placement, faculty, completion, licensure or retention are verified constraints.
cases.decision_trigger: Expand general nursing capacity only when local evidence shows education seats or faculty, rather than clinical placement, completion/licensure, specialty hiring or retention, are the binding constraint.

cases.title: Heavy Equipment & Industrial Maintenance
cases.current_response: Use Yuba College manufacturing, hydraulics and welding as the technical base for SANY/MIS and other equipment-intensive employers. Add equipment diagnostics, inspection, controls or service modules only where employers validate recurring gaps.
cases.decision_trigger: Add a module or cohort only when multiple employers validate the same recurring skill/capacity gap and existing Yuba College programs plus employer OJT cannot meet it.
